subject: Orchestration sprint — QBR + OKR alignment ahead of go-live
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@hyperloop.ai>
Date: Sat, 1 May 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Orchestration sprint — QBR + OKR alignment ahead of go-live

Team —

We’re nine days out from the internal go-live window for the HyperLoop pilot and I want a short cross-functional check to lock down open risks for the QBR presentation next week. High-level asks:

- Confirm enablement artifacts (quickstarts, FAQ) and delivery owner
- Confirm pricing tiers & any conditional discounts for pilot procurement
- Ops: staging load test pass / fallback targets
- Docs: final links + near-term update cadence
- CS: 1-pager for exec QBR and customer-facing kickoff note

I attached the current runbook (runbook_v3.pdf) — it’s annotated with owners but we need firm sign-offs by EOD Monday. I’ll capture the final slide for the QBR once we have confirmations.

Quick schedule proposal: 30m sync Monday 10:00am PT if that works for everyone; otherwise reply with blockers.

Thanks,
Karthik
VP, Commercial Strategy
Redwood Inference

Attachment: runbook_v3.pdf (PDF, 96KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Orchestration sprint — QBR + OKR alignment ahead of go-live

Karthik —

Thanks for the runbook. From enablement/CS perspective:

- Quickstart deck: final draft ready; slide set attached as enablement_quickstart.pptx. Need copy review from Olga by EOD Tues.
- FAQ: I’ve flagged 12 pilot-specific Qs (support SLAs, data residency, rollback expectations) — putting these into a one-page FAQ we can share with the customer at kickoff. Owner: Monica.
- Training: 2x 45-min sessions scheduled for the customer on day+2 and day+7 post-go-live. Materials will be recorded and uploaded.
- QBR one-pager: Draft outline below — want to make the customer success ask concise for execs: success metrics, known risks, expected next milestones.

Draft QBR one-pager bullets:
• Pilot objective & scope
• Current readiness score (see runbook page 4)
• Key risks & mitigations (ops, pricing exceptions)
• Customer adoption plan + enablement timeline
• Ask for exec: approval for up to a one-time pilot discount (per your note)

I’ll join Monday 10am PT.

Marissa
Senior Manager, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

Attachment: enablement_quickstart.pptx (PPTX, 1.8MB)

Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Orchestration sprint — QBR + OKR alignment ahead of go-live

Quick ops update:

- Staging load tests completed yesterday. Baseline: 75th p50 latency at target for 10 TPS sustained with current batching. Spike test to 30 TPS produced graceful degradation; fallback plan verified (route to smaller model variant + burst capacity).
- Outstanding: KV cache warmup script needs final validation for long-sequence prompts (Monica/Olga to validate with customer sample prompts).
- SLA ask: HyperLoop procurement requested a 99.5% uptime target for pilot — that’s within Dedicated capacity, but we need a written acknowledgement in the purchase order for a temporary SLA exception. Markus — can you confirm if we can accommodate in pilot terms?

I’m aligned for Monday 10am. I’ll bring the staging logs and a short run-through of the fallback procedure.

Rishi
Senior Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Orchestration sprint — QBR + OKR alignment ahead of go-live

Karthik / team —

We can support the pilot pricing that was sketched last week. Summary:

- Pilot tier: volume up to 2M tokens / month at pilot rate (matrix attached — pricing_matrix_v2.xlsx)
- One-time pilot discount: approved up to 20% (requires Sanctioned Discount sign-off from Finance; Vivek, can we get a quick approval path?)
- SLA acknowledgement: we can include a temporary 99.5% uptime target for the pilot term; legal will route a short addendum.

Notes for QBR slide: list the pilot rate, discount cap, and required procurement PO language (procurement: please include the SLA addendum clause or we cannot guarantee the temporary target).

-Markus
Head of Pricing and Packaging
Redwood Inference

Attachment: pricing_matrix_v2.xlsx (XLSX, 42KB)

To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@hyperloop.ai>, HyperLoop Analytics Procurement <procurement@hyperloop.ai>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Orchestration sprint — QBR + OKR alignment ahead of go-live

Appreciate the quick turn. Final decisions and actions for QBR deck and go-live:

1) Enablement / CS
- Owner: Marissa. Deliverables: enablement_quickstart.pptx (final) and 1-page FAQ by Tue EOD. Marissa to upload to the Drive link and tag Olga for copy edits.

2) Ops
- Owner: Rishi. Action: run KV cache warmup validation with customer sample prompts by Tue EOD; confirm fallback drill checklist in the runbook. Staging logs to be included in QBR appendix.

3) Pricing / Procurement
- Owner: Markus. Pilot pricing matrix accepted; Finance to sign off on the one-time discount cap. Procurement (HyperLoop) — please confirm PO language includes the temporary SLA addendum clause by close of business Wednesday.

4) Docs / Product Collateral
- Owner: Olga. Final doc links and short change log to be in-place before go-live; small live edits allowed but no structural doc changes after go-live.

5) QBR & Exec Ask
- Owner: Karthik/Vivek. Karthik will finalize the QBR slide (two slides) and circulate by Thurs. Vivek: please confirm the executive approval path for the discount.

6) Risks (top 3 called out for execs):
- SLA addendum missing in PO (mitigation: delayed pilot start by 48 hours)
- KV cache edge-case with long sequences (mitigation: rollback to smaller model variant)
- Last-minute doc changes that affect enablement (mitigation: freeze of structural changes)

Please reply with any objections. If no objections by EOD Wed we’ll mark this ready for QBR and I’ll consolidate the slide deck. Elena — thanks for being on the thread; procurement team, please confirm SLA language as requested.

Karthik
VP, Commercial Strategy
Redwood Inference

Attachment: consolidated_go-live_playbook_link (Drive)
